data_preparation: With seed 42 and the section defaults, toy-text should have 9/1/2 records and families; attributes-sft should have 45/5/10 records but 9/1/2 families. The manifest-reading fence should print these counts and one raw line for each side.
save_start_original: The original baseline fence should print its no-update message and create a step-0 width-32 one-layer CPU checkpoint; it does not evaluate or update the model.
validation_baseline: For the seeded generated files, text validation should score 35 targets and SFT validation 36, with no skipped rows. I do not predict exact NLL or generated IDs. An untrained model is not expected to have reliable circle/square answers.
compare_original_no_update_control: If I evaluate the same start checkpoint twice under identical conditions, the comparison script should print equal before/after metrics and samples, preserve the 36-target denominator, and create the comparison JSON. This is a no-update control for the reading/comparison script, not a post-training improvement test.
compare_guard_exercise: If I deliberately change only after.effective_tokens from 36 to 35 in a copied report, the effective-token assertion should stop the original comparison before it creates a new comparison file. This tests how I would locate an exercise failure without removing the assertion.
cpu_scope: I will not execute any training, download, CUDA, or full course-experiment command. GPU tables and prose remain cited earlier experiments, not my measurements.
